title: New Hire in Newsroom Operations
body_markdown:
Anna Simpson has joined Newsroom Operations as D.C. senior operations manager. Read more in the below note from director of Newsroom Operations Juanita Powell-Brunson.


We are excited to announce that Anna Simpson joined Newsroom Operations this week as our new senior operations manager in the Washington bureau.


Anna will manage our D.C. office operations, overseeing a large portfolio that includes supporting employees in Washington and leading space planning​ and operational management of the bureau.


Anna brings nearly a decade of operations experience to The Times. She most recently served as an operations specialist at Crowell & Moring LLP, where she led operational planning, streamlined workflows, managed complex logistics and partnered with cross-functional teams.


Anna holds a Master of Public Health from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and a bachelor’s degree from Franklin & Marshall College. Outside of work, she enjoys reading, traveling, cooking and barre class.


Please join us in welcoming Anna to the team.


— Juanita
